11:func parseSlogLevel(s string) (slog.Level, error) {
12:	switch strings.ToLower(s) {
13:	case "debug":
14:		return slog.LevelDebug, nil
15:	case "info":
16:		return slog.LevelInfo, nil
17:	case "warn":
18:		return slog.LevelWarn, nil
19:	case "error":
20:		return slog.LevelError, nil
21:	default:
22:		return slog.LevelInfo, errors.Errorf("unknown log level %q: must be debug, info, warn, or error", s)
23:	}
24:}

26:func newLogger(level slog.Level, w io.Writer) *slog.Logger {
27:	return slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(w, &slog.HandlerOptions{Level: level}))
